description: Declarative rules that assign each LCC spending row a record_class. Rules are evaluated in the order listed; the first match wins. Default fall-through is procurement_paid. Derived from raw-CSV audit 2026-04-18 (see investigations/DEEP_AUDIT_2026-04-18.md).

rules.reason: Oracle Fusion month-end / year-end accrual journals (R12 AP Expense + Inventory Accrual, AP Liability, Materials Valuation). In the Apr 2024 - Apr 2026 corpus: 14,698 rows / GBP 141.6m, concentrated in Mar 2025 (GBP 64.4m) + Apr 2025 (GBP 77.2m) — the 2024/25 year-end accrual exercise. Accruals reverse when the invoice clears; summing with paid invoices double-counts. PATTERN IS UPPERCASE: the classifier matches on uppercased fields, so a mixed-case pattern never fires (this rule was dead until 11 Jun 2026 for exactly that reason).

230,249 rows (29% of corpus, £272.6M). Direct payments to named individuals — foster carers, SGO recipients, ASC service-user direct-payment holders, Staying Put arrangements, CYP Direct Payments. Personal data lawfully redacted under Care Act 2014 s.31 + UK GDPR.
75,149 rows, £615,885 total (avg £8.20). Bank-transfer reversals + settlement fees under finance-system clearing labels. Not suppliers.

LCC's in-house directly-provided adult social care arm — day centres at Clitheroe (Mearley Fold), Accrington (Woodhaven), Colne (Byron View), Bacup (Parkside) + residential units. CQC provider 1-101642168. Money from LCC commissioner to LCC provider. Not third-party procurement.
